business_problem: However, their decentralized data structure posed significant challenges. Previously, on the legacy structure, stakeholders were not comfortable with our access to the data, so we couldn’t use it.
solution_summary: The Government Technology Agency of Singapore (GovTech) employs 4,000 professionals to enhance public sector digital transformation. Facing limitations with their on-premises data analytics and visualization system, GovTech migrated to the Databricks Data + AI Platform on AWS. Integrating Databricks as the data backbone for GovTech’s data strategy has improved data security, governance and collaboration, allowing the organization to support use cases in recruitment, finance planning, procurement and more. GovTech’s data journey started with an on-premises dashboarding server and building dashboards was the only way to serve data to stakeholders, but this process could take up to three months and licenses were costly.
business_outcome: GovTech Singapore achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 3x faster dashboard creation, from 90 to 30 days; 50% data democratization across corporate divisions in the first year; 8,000 hours of labor resources saved annually with Databricks.
